channel.title: Late Brake blog
channel.description: Formula 1 news, history, fun facts and what happened on this day.

item.title: Piastri ends management deal with Mark Webber after seven years
item.description: McLaren's Oscar Piastri and his managers Mark Webber and Ann Neal have agreed to end the partnership that began in 2019.

item.title: Six F1 Las Vegas Grand Prix facts that sound made up
item.description: A race in a hotel car park, three champions crowned in fifth place and a loose cover that stopped practice: six true F1 stories from Las Vegas.

item.title: Leclerc penalised for Lawson clash after F1 São Paulo GP
item.description: Charles Leclerc dropped from seventh to eighth after a five-second penalty for hitting Liam Lawson, while Antonelli and Bearman were also punished.

item.title: On this day: Rosberg's Interlagos win and Norris's 2025 victory
item.description: Two F1 Brazilian races held on 9 November: Nico Rosberg's 2014 win that took the title to Abu Dhabi, and Lando Norris's dominant 2025 weekend.

item.title: Norris wins wet F1 São Paulo GP as Mercedes clinch the title
item.description: Lando Norris won a rain-hit F1 São Paulo Grand Prix ahead of Max Verstappen, while Mercedes sealed their ninth constructors' championship.

item.title: How Verstappen won from 17th in the 2024 Interlagos rain
item.description: Max Verstappen started the 2024 F1 São Paulo Grand Prix 17th in torrential rain and won by almost 20 seconds, all but settling his fourth title.

item.title: F1 extends Brazilian Grand Prix deal at Interlagos to 2035
item.description: Formula 1 has agreed a five-year extension with the São Paulo race, keeping the Brazilian Grand Prix at Interlagos until at least 2035.

item.title: On this day: Berger wins in Adelaide as Senna and Mansell collide
item.description: Lotus podium finisher Peter Arundell was born on 8 November 1933, and Gerhard Berger won a dramatic 1992 season finale in Adelaide.

item.title: Norris takes wet F1 São Paulo pole as Russell rues aborted lap
item.description: Lando Norris took pole for the F1 São Paulo Grand Prix in heavy rain at Interlagos, with grid penalties promoting Kimi Antonelli to second.

item.title: Six F1 Monaco Grand Prix facts that sound made up
item.description: A winner from 14th, a leader who swam out of the harbour and a race nobody wanted to win: six true stories from the F1 Monaco Grand Prix.

item.title: Russell to take five-place grid penalty at F1 São Paulo GP
item.description: George Russell will drop five places on the F1 São Paulo Grand Prix grid after Mercedes fitted his sixth internal combustion engine of 2026.

item.title: On this day: Senna's last win and Red Bull's first F1 title
item.description: Senna won for the last time in 1993, Red Bull took its first constructors' title at Interlagos in 2010 and Verstappen won in Mexico in 2021.

item.title: Antonelli tops F1 São Paulo practice after Norris leads FP1
item.description: New F1 champion Kimi Antonelli set the fastest lap of Friday at Interlagos, after McLaren's Lando Norris topped first practice.

item.title: How Williams won its first F1 race at Silverstone in 1979
item.description: Alan Jones dominated the 1979 British Grand Prix until his engine failed, and team-mate Clay Regazzoni drove on to give Williams its first F1 win.

item.title: Mercedes can clinch F1 constructors' title at Interlagos
item.description: Mercedes lead Ferrari by 126 points and will seal a ninth F1 constructors' title at the São Paulo Grand Prix if they outscore Ferrari by three points.

item.title: On this day: Hill's Suzuka rain win and Hülkenberg's first pole
item.description: Damon Hill won a soaked 1994 Japanese Grand Prix on 6 November, Nico Hülkenberg took his first pole at Interlagos in 2010, and Peter Collins was born in 1931.

item.title: Alan Jones, 1980 F1 champion and Williams' first, dies aged 80
item.description: Australian Alan Jones, who won the 1980 F1 world title as Williams' first champion and took 12 Grand Prix wins, has died aged 80 after a short illness.

item.title: Six F1 debut facts that sound made up, but are true
item.description: A winner first time out, a pole on debut and a 17-year-old starter: six true stories from drivers' first F1 races, as Rafael Camara prepares for his.

item.title: NTT to join McLaren F1 team as official partner from 2027
item.description: Japanese technology group NTT, title sponsor of the IndyCar series, has signed a multi-year deal with McLaren's F1 team built around artificial intelligence.

item.title: On this day: Boutsen's Adelaide rain win and Verstappen's 52nd
item.description: Thierry Boutsen won a soaked 1989 Australian Grand Prix on 5 November, and Max Verstappen passed Alain Prost's win total at Interlagos on the same date in 2023.

item.title: Herta to run Perez's Cadillac in F1 practice at Interlagos
item.description: Colton Herta will drive in first practice at the São Paulo Grand Prix after a mix-up left him one point short of an F1 superlicence.

item.title: How Hamilton won the 2008 F1 title in the last corners at Interlagos
item.description: Felipe Massa won the 2008 Brazilian Grand Prix at home, but Lewis Hamilton passed Timo Glock in the final corners to take the title by one point.

item.title: McLaren brings 2027 front wing idea to F1 São Paulo Grand Prix
item.description: McLaren will run new front wing, rear wing and floor parts at Interlagos as it chases third place, and expects the wing concept to carry into 2027.

item.title: On this day: F1's 500th race and Räikkönen's Abu Dhabi win
item.description: Nelson Piquet won F1's 500th championship race in Adelaide on 4 November 1990, and Kimi Räikkönen won for Lotus in Abu Dhabi on the same date in 2012.

item.title: Haas drops Ocon for rest of 2026 as Camara gets F1 debut in Brazil
item.description: Haas has told Esteban Ocon he will not race for the team again this season, and Brazilian rookie Rafael Camara will make his F1 debut at Interlagos.

item.title: Six F1 title facts that sound made up, but are true
item.description: A champion by half a point, a champion who never knew he had won and a title lost despite scoring more points. Six true stories of F1 title fights.

item.title: New F1 champion Antonelli to keep his 12 instead of number 1
item.description: Kimi Antonelli will not switch to the champion's number 1 in 2027, so the number will be missing from the F1 grid for the first time since 2021.

item.title: F1 São Paulo Grand Prix 2026: race time in India and full schedule
item.description: The F1 São Paulo Grand Prix at Interlagos starts at 10:30pm India time on Sunday 8 November. Here is every session in India time.

item.title: Penalties drop Piastri and both Alpines out of F1 Mexico points
item.description: Post-race penalties for Oscar Piastri, Franco Colapinto and Pierre Gasly reshaped the Mexico City Grand Prix result and gave Ryo Hirakawa a debut point.

item.title: How Vettel spun at Interlagos and still won the 2012 F1 title
item.description: Sebastian Vettel was hit on the first lap of the 2012 Brazilian Grand Prix and fell to 22nd, then fought back to sixth to beat Fernando Alonso by three points.
